data.title: 克洛伊 · 游戏厅的连胜
data.description: 放学后游戏厅，她盘腿坐在格斗游戏机前打出连胜，围观的小学生越来越多；赢到最后的仰天大笑毫无形象，是真正的孩子气瞬间。
data.action: 放学后游戏厅，她盘腿坐在格斗游戏机前打出连胜，围观的小学生越来越多
data.promptProse: Chloe sits cross-legged at the fighting-game cabinet with both hands poised over its buttons, sleeves pushed back from the wrists of her red cardigan and white school blouse. Her orange eyes follow the screen before a broad victory grin opens. The medium view retains the knee-length pleated skirt and cabinet controls, arcade machines farther back. Colored screen light traces pale-pink hair and fingertips, with dimmer cabinet sides framing the seated pose.
